notes.title: NEW VERSION: 1.1.60.1 | All New Power Commands Added (nb: steam overlay = broken)
notes.notes:
IMPORTANT: steam overlay IS currently not working with the new update.

UPDATE NOTES: 1.1.60.1

-----------------------------------------------------------
AUTO ADD TO INTELLISENSE
-----------------------------------------------------------

1. certain commands will now automatically add items to intellisense now, e.g. obj is takeable would add take obj to intellisense.

-----------------------------------------------------------
ENTER / EXIT TRIGGERS SCRIPT
-----------------------------------------------------------

2. on-enter & on-exit triggers now in place, it will look for a script based on the direction they enter / leave and run it if present; i.e. on-exit-e OR on-enter-se.

-----------------------------------------------------------
GLOBAL ACCESS TO DATA
-----------------------------------------------------------

3. you can now get global access to anything to amend / update data etc by using;

> entity\param\value
> room\param\value

i.e. box\isvisible\n
i.e. dungeon\name\dingy dungeon

------------------------------------------------------------------
RUN COMMANDS FROM ANOTHER LOCATION
------------------------------------------------------------------

4. you can now run select commands remotely.

> select entity/roomname/or?
> build box
> deselect

-------------------------------------------------------------------
REPLACE COMMAND
-------------------------------------------------------------------

5. replace commands can be used to replace any string or number or combination of from all data sources (USE with caution)

> replaceall this&that
> replacekey this&that
> replacevalue this&that

-------------------------------------------------------------------
WRITE DIRECT TO SCRIPT
-------------------------------------------------------------------

6. writescript commands that allow scripts to be constructed manually via scripting

> writescript scriptname

> writelocal towrite; (always terminate with ;) - writes data to local script
> writeglobal towrite
> writeprivate towrite

> clearlocal scriptname - clears a local script of any data (retains key)
> clearglobal scriptname
> clearprivate scriptname

> dellocal scriptname - deletes local script data
> delglobal scriptname
> delprivate scriptname

----------------------------------------------------------------
FETCH COMMAND/S
----------------------------------------------------------------

7. new fetch commands allow you to grab any data based on search params! the result values will be stored as follows;

SYS[FETCH-COUNT] - number of results matched.
SYS[FETCHX] i.e. 1-x

> fetchlocal x
> fetchglobal y
> fetchprivate z

Once fetched, you can then use SYS[FETCH] to use the found data.

i.e. room name is %SYS[FETCH]%

-----------------------------------------------------------------

I will also be working on a tutorial map that will help demonstrate adliberum engine's plethora of commands.

~ Liam

notes.title: ADLENGINE BUILD 1.1.55.4... NOW LIVE! = FOR LOOP, WHICH.. IS (SELECT CASE), ARRAYS & BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
Lots of cool new stuff in this build.

[h1]WHICH.. IS (select case)[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29210544/2ca50335534003f9c2d02fcb35db2ccfd053b0e4.gif[/img]

[how to use] first add IS statements by doing the following
[code]isXYZ:do something[/code]

IS accepts boolean 0-1, true/false, numbers  0-9, y/n or can also accept custom naming.

e.g.

[code]is0:room is dark
is1:room is light[/code]

or..

[code]isneg:narrate -1
isneutral:narrate 0
ispos: narrate 1
[/code]

To run a WHICH check:
[code]which %cranelever%[/code]


[h1]FOR LOOPS[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29210544/d48e9cec2dfd1401bcb93be959bf741e563de7ce.gif[/img]

FOR loops allow you to loop a task X amount of times.

e.g.

To set a FOR LOOP:
[code]
for:do testscript
[/code]

To run a FOR LOOP:
[code]
for 0-10
[/code]

Example Script Content To Run:
[code]
testscript:
narrate %x%;
~x+1
[/code]

Where x in my example are array entries containing simple map data 0/1s


[h1]ARRAYS[/h1]

Array like data can be defined using variables. For example:

[code]
#map[0]=0
#map[1]=1
#map[2]=0

#map[0][0]=1
#map[1][0]=0
#map[2][0]=1

#map[0][0][1]=0
#map[1][0][4]=1
#map[2][0][7]=1
[/code]

See complex specials below.


[h1]'COMPLEX%SPECIALS%'[/h1]

Complex specials first swap out any data surrounded by %% and then surrounded by ' '

For example:
[code]

~pX=%player.x%;
~pY=%player.y%;
~pZ=%player.z%;
#'map[%pX%][%pY%][%pZ%]'=BUNKER ENTRANCE[/code]

Currently it works using temp vars as above not direct calls to player.var or target.var.

[h1]DELAY x[/h1]
You can now specify a delay before the next script action processes. The delay runs until the delay value reaches 0, subtracting 1 each tick. The value can hold any number but bear in mind too high a number will result in too long a delay!

short delay:
[code]delay 100[/code]

long delay:
[code]delay 1000[/code]


[h1]NEW TIMER COMMANDS[/h1]

[b]START TIMER[/b] - resumes an active timer.
[code]stop timer 0[/code]


[b]STOP TIMER[/b] - pauses an active timer.
[code]stop timer 10[/code]

[b]ERASE TIMER[/b] - deletes an active timer.
[code]erase timer 5[/code]

Timers will need to be micromanaged. The best way would be to create a variable pointer to timers you want to have control over. Timers are incremented from 0 and their data is stored in session_map_data. Type edit session to view.

[code]
#healtimer=1;
start timer %healtimer%[/code]
[/code]


[h1]BUGS FIXED[/h1]

[b]TIMED EVENTS[/b] are now working again!
[code]after x second do something[/code]
[code]every x minutes do something[/code]

[b]DELETE MULTIPLE CHARACTERS[/b]
Delete no longer deletes multiple characters occasionally when pressing backspace.

[b]DELETE KEY:[/b]
no longer deletes entire code entry while text is being rendered, was most notable when adlengine was loading if you made mistakes trying to enter commands and had to delete characters.

notes.title: UPDATE: about VARS
notes.notes:
After much testing, I determined using letters was not a good replacement for symbols so the new symbols coming in the next update for vars are:

$ = local variable

i.e.
[code]$grillstatus=open[/code]

# = global variable
[code]#orchealth=100[/code]

~ = private variable
[code]~phealth=100[/code]

You will use these symbols to manipulate also.

notes.title: %special% coming in next update
notes.notes:
MORE EXCITING NEWS!

when constructing commands you will soon be able to use surrounding %%'s to have the command lookup special values. You can use any number of them in a command and it will replace all before processing the command.

for example we could set up a variable:
[code]gvar=hello[/code]

in our command we can then do the following:
[code]build %var%[/code]

using the %s looks up the value against all the special properties including but not limited to:
[list]
[*]local vars
[*]global vars
[*]private vars
[*]random (value randomly rolled)
[*]chosen (value randomly picked from the choice command)
[/list]

You could also assign a var to player.var or target.var and then use this as a special.

Another use could be to assign special values as part of a description. For example.
[code]
lgrillstatus=closed
grill.if opened lgrillstatus=open
grill.if closed lgrillstatus=closed
You are standing in a dungeon, a grill in the floor lies %grillstatus%
[/code]

I am sure we will all be able to use this to great effect.

This will be live in the next update.

notes.title: IMPORTANT: changes to setting vars coming... PLUS global / private
notes.notes:
UPDATE: CHANGE OF PLANS:
$ = local
# = global
~ = private


instead of just #
you will use $ (for local)
i.e.
[code]
$varname=100
[/code]

NEW global vars:
use (#) to set a global var..
i.e.
[code]#varname=[/code]

NEW private vars:
or (~) to set a private var...
i.e.
[code]~varname=[/code]

This will be live in the next update!

All combinations have been confirmed working, to manipulate you would need to do:
[code]
$clockhours+timehours;
#timeleft-1;
~health*roomdamage;
[/code]

Just be aware that it also currently doesn't prevent you from creating duplicate variable names across each scope so its a good idea to use unique vars until I can address this issue at a later date.

notes.title: UPDATE: ADL-ED + ADLENGINE v1.1.55.3
notes.notes:
Big update this one:

[h1]Download the (experimental) editor at:[/h1]
https://www.adliberum.com/engine/ADL-ED/

The new engine update is live on steam and will update for you shortly.

I will do a brief guide on using the editor although hopefully a lot is self explanatory. It "should" also work with your current maps. Just load them in top-left.

The engine will only sync between engine -> adl-ed (and back again) initially by either typing:
[code]sync[/code]
In the engine..

OR pressing the "sync to adlengine" button in the editor.

[b]NB: CREATIVE MODE must be active![/b] to sync... the editor / engine will sync automatically between once connection has been established and the content has been mirrored for the first time. However you can use the sync command or sync to adlengine button to sync, if there are any issues.

Let me know how you get on :)

----------------------------------

Arrow keys scroll the map

Q W E R
A S D F
Z X C = move in editor
R & F = move up / down a floor

space = build room

U I O P
J K L ;
M , . = build / toggle exits
P & ; = build / toggle exits up / down

-----------------------------------

Any issues, let me know, like I said its experimental so may have a few teething issues. 

[h1]NB: CREATIVE MODE must be active! to sync...[/h1]

notes.title: QUICK UPDATE: ALL NEW EDITOR FUNCTIONALITY!
notes.notes:
The built-in editor has been given a whole array of tools to help make editing the world / map even easier.

To open the editor:
[code]editor[/code]

You can teleport directly to items in the left list by double clicking OR you can perform actions on the selected item.

You can add a new room, edit rooms, objects, export, run scripts and more. I will try to do a video demonstrating the editor and how to use it.

The right hand side is for scripts and will accept copy and paste, can be exported, run and more! Don't forget to terminate lines with a ;

~ L

notes.title: ADLENGINE PATCH (NOW 1.1.55.2o) - MAJOR EXITS FIX + QUICK MAP EDITOR + EDIT COMMANDS
notes.notes:
This update brings a major fix to the exits, which now should work perfectly!

i.e. build exit e

Using the build room command instead of the build exit command will force move you into the new room...


[h1]PLUS - QUICK MAP EDITOR[/h1]

The all new quick map editor / map. To access the map enter the command map or m for short.

[u]In Creative Mode:[/u]

hover over the exit slots and hold ALT + Click Right Mouse Button to toggle exits ON / OFF.

Hold ALT + click Left Mouse Button to toggle an existing exit as OPEN / CLOSED / LOCKED.

Click the Middle Mouse Button over an existing exit to force move in that direction.

[u]In Play Mode:[/u]

Double click Left mouse button over an exit to move in that direction.


[h1]PLUS - NEW EDIT COMMANDS[/h1]

The all new edit commands.

You can now edit the raw data behind your world/game using the following commands:
[code]
edit config[/code]
Allows you to edit settings.

[code]edit session[/code]
Allows you to edit exit data / timed events on the fly.

[code]edit map[/code]
Allows you to quickly tweak / edit the map.

[code]edit scripts[/code]
Allows you to edit scripts that have been stored.

[code]edit custom[/code]
Allows you to edit custom scripts that you've created from using the if command.

[code]edit events[/code]
Allows you to edit event data. Access events timeline using events

[code]edit inv[/code]
Allows you to tweak / edit the players inventory, including equipped and worn items.

[code]edit private[/code]
Allows you to edit any private data.

[code]edit lookup[/code]
Allows you to edit the lookup data.

[code]edit lang[/code]
Allows you to edit the language data.

All changes will be automatically saved every 5 seconds, press the update button to commit the changes and refresh the map (look).

These new commands will help you to make minor tweaks to data rather than always typing out full commands. 

The data format is .json which if you understand the structure you could also add / delete your own data manually.


[h1]PLUS - ALL NEW ROOM COLOR AS IMAGE OPTIONS.[/h1]

[code]
room image is black
room image is grey
room image is dark grey
room image is red
room image is blue
room image is green
room image is orange
room image is purple
room image is teal
[/code]

notes.title: 1.1.55.1b is now LIVE! Biggest Update To-Date!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this is the biggest update I've done to-date, below I've listed all the cool new stuff, bug fixes and more.

Please let me know how you are getting on with the engine, if there is anything holding you back or if there are things you would like to see added.

Make sure to check out and vote on the official development roadmap at https://trello.com/b/fb5sKcHx/adlengine-dev-roadmap

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------


NEW: [b]Intellisense now suggests words / commands as you type.[/b]
[code] - intellisense on / off
 - all active commands should appear as suggestions.
 - use tab key to accept and use the suggestion.
[/code]

NEW: [b]ability to add an object / word / phrase to INTELLISENSE?[/b]
[code] - intellisense:phrase to add
 - best used to add custom commands / command variations to intellisense
[/code]

NEW: [b]cycle last-typed command history with UP ARROW / DOWN ARROW[/b]
[code] - gives quick access to previously typed commands / aids error correction.
[/code]
------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]NEW COMMANDS:[/h1]
-------------

NEW: [b]creative can also be called to enable / disable creative mode.[/b]

NEW: [b]to attach objectname requires objectname[/b]
[code] - i.e. to attach rope requires glue
 - i.e. to detach lid requires screwdriver
[/code]
NEW: [b]detach objectname[/b]
[code] - i.e. detach rope[/code]

NEW: [b]objects can now be made detachable / not detachable[/b]
[code] - i.e. rope is detachable
 - i.e. handle is part of door
 - i.e. handle is not detachable
[/code]

------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Experimental:[/h1]
-------------

[b]NPCS are an experimental addition.. what they can currently do:[/b]
[code] - visible in who's here.
 - ai can open doors
 - ai can move from room to room
 - ai can take objects that are visible / not glued down ;)
[/code]

NEW: [b]NPC/AI characters can be added using:[/b]
[code] - build ainame.ai
 - i.e. build bob.ai
[/code]

NPC/AI: [b]npc characters AI now runs anywhere, previously it would only run in the same room as the player.[/b]

------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Options / Accessibility:[/h1]
------------------------

NEW: [b]font size is small / medium / large[/b]
[code] - changes the font size for the text renderer.[/code]

NEW: [b]delete key now repeats if held.[/b]

NEW: [b]ctrl + backspace[/b]
[code] - deletes the entire current command entry[/code]

------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Theme / Customisation:[/h1]
----------------------

NEW: [b]border color is black / white / red / green / blue[/b]
NEW: [b]bg color is black / white / red / green / blue[/b]
NEW: [b]font color is black / white / red / green / blue[/b]
[code] - there appears to be a bug when font color and bg color are both changed that stops the text renderer rendering.[/code]

------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Scripting / Custom Commands:[/h1]
----------------------------

NEW: [b]force n / e / s / w / ne / nw / se / sw / u / d[/b]
[code] - allows you to force move the player in a direction, i.e. if they find an alternative way to exit, that others havent.[/code]


------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Enhancements / Minor Fixes:[/h1]
---------------------------

NEW: [b]Add ! (If placed at end of command forces feedback on) ie. Take dirt![/b]
[code] - used when calling commands from script commands such as IF or via .verbose files.
 - Mostly important for custom events and timeline events!!!
 - (still to add) = Add to timeline events!!! Needs to store if feedback or no!
[/code]

FIX: [b]change the relative exit in the next room when closing one in your current room... i.e. close n = close s in the next room...[/b]
[code] - if you close the exit north, the exit in the room to the north that leads south will now also close.[/code]

------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Bugs / Fixes:[/h1]
-------------

BUG FIXED: [b]attached objects are now VISIBLE.[/b]

BUG FIXED: [b]Custom commands now work outside of creative mode.[/b]

BUG FIXED: [b]custom commands no longer feed back the command when called![/b]

BUG FIXED: [b]typed command no longer lost when processing commands[/b]

FIX: [b]creative mode ON adds creative commands to intellisense... OFF = deletes.[/b]
[code] - intellisense commands for creative mode now activate / deactivate[/code]

FIX: [b]strip save file of creative and general intellisense.. / (anything thats added on launch that isnt custom)[/b]
[code] - reduced file size for .adlengine game files.[/code]

FIX: [b]build exit builds exit relative (in the next room) i.e. build exit n (in start room) builds an exit s (in the next room)[/b]
[code] - adds two-way exits now.[/code]


Thanks for your continued support.

~ Liam
